what_they_do: ZeroDrift is a compliance firewall that sits between AI models and end users at regulated enterprises (banks, broker-dealers, RIAs, insurers, healthcare providers/payers). It intercepts every AI-generated message or agent output in real time via a single API gateway change, checks it against regulations (SEC, FINRA, FCA, MiFID II, HIPAA, NAIC) and firm-specific policies, and returns a verdict (Pass, Rewrite, Block, or Escalate) with citations to the rule that applied. This replaces the manual, after-the-fact process where compliance officers read outbound communications, chat transcripts, and agent logs by hand to catch violations.
vertical: AI governance and compliance infrastructure for regulated industries (financial services, insurance, healthcare)
theme_fit_rationale: Primary fit is Theme 9 (Agentic security infrastructure): ZeroDrift is literally runtime policy enforcement plus audit trails/activity logging for AI agent and model outputs, delivered as a governance layer (Gateway API proxy, Policy engine, Command dashboard) that gives enterprises visibility into and control over what AI systems are allowed to say or do, one of the theme's named use cases verbatim. Secondary fit is Theme 6 (AI-native platforms replacing labor with outcome-based services): the product directly displaces manual compliance review labor in the theme's named verticals (insurance, healthcare, financial services), with every enforcement decision generating labeled data that should make the underlying compliance model more accurate over time.
